info.name: SmartFab API
info.description:
SmartFab: Production Monitoring and Equipment Maintenance System — REST API (/api/v1).

Run the "Auth" folder first: it logs in each seeded role and stores the tokens. The whole collection can be run top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner on a freshly seeded database (npm run seed).

request.description: Logs in the seeded Admin account and stores the token in {{adminToken}}.

Logs in the seeded Operator account and stores the token in {{operatorToken}}.
Logs in the seeded Technician account and stores the token in {{technicianToken}}.
